shared_or_similar_visual_information: A sector of a circle bounded by two radii and a circular arc. On the left, use the dark gray sector enclosed by two radii and a circular arc, next to 120°. On the right, use the dark upper-right quarter of spinner A, labeled 6.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: It selects the 120-degree sector as a geometric area. Right image: This sector is the outcome that supplies the tens digit 6 in N.
Rationales: The left sector defines a geometric area to measure. The numeral inside the right sector is an outcome of a spinner, which enters a probability calculation.
